The b1e1d3f03 addition to route-admission.test.ts closes the previously-flagged gap: it now exercises the BUILD-only (trivial) route and the DEF-present story-role requirement through the real `prepareReviewAdmission` -> `readStoryRoute` path, not a mock. However, the new task-review-plan-path.test.ts's second assertion block (the "skipped when the packet has none" half of its own title) does not actually discriminate the fix from the pre-fix behavior: tracing both code paths shows the rejection in both cases is a `TaskReviewInputError` (never a `TypeError`) whose message never matches `/Plan identity must match review subject/`, so the two assertions it makes pass identically whether or not the task-review-rpc.ts guard was made conditional. This undermines the one dedicated regression test for that acceptance check.

findings.message: The test's second half, which claims to prove the plan-path identity check 'is skipped when the packet has none', does not discriminate the fix from the pre-fix behavior. Pre-fix, a missing plan document was rejected earlier in the same function by `requireReview(packet.documents.plan, 'documents.plan', 'Expected a plan document')`, which throws a `TaskReviewInputError` (not a `TypeError`) whose message is 'documents.plan: Expected a plan document' -- it never matches `/Plan identity must match review subject/`. Post-fix, the same request instead falls through to `coordinator.start` -> `prepareReviewAdmission` -> `routedDocuments`, which (since the empty temp repo has no stored BUILD/LLD/etc.) rejects with a *different* `TaskReviewInputError` ('documents: Expected the documents none for this Story's route, got lld'), which is also not a `TypeError` and also does not match the Plan-identity regex. So `assert.ok(!(skipped instanceof TypeError), ...)` and `assert.doesNotMatch(String(skipped), /Plan identity must match review subject/, ...)` both pass whether or not the `if (packet.documents.plan)` guard in task-review-rpc.ts:43 is present. The test cannot catch a regression of the behavior it names, leaving that half of the stated acceptance check ('...is skipped when the packet has none') without working coverage.
findings.rationale: task-review-rpc.ts's own removal of the unconditional `requireReview(packet.documents.plan, ...)` line (confirmed by diff) means a `TaskReviewInputError` with message 'Expected a plan document' can no longer be produced at all from that line -- but the test asserts absence of a *different* error (TypeError / Plan-identity message) rather than absence of that specific message or any positive signal that execution proceeded past the removed check. Both the fixed and reverted versions of the guarded line produce an error satisfying both assertions, verified by tracing the control flow of `startTaskReview`, `buildAuthorParty` (catches ENOENT, returns 'unknown'), `coordinator.start`, `readStoryRoute` (catches ENOENT on the missing BUILD file) and `routedDocuments`'s required-vs-supplied check for an empty temp repo with only an `lld` document in the packet.
